description: This Java interface defines a client for sending commands to a device using Eclipse Hono's Command and Control API. It includes methods for sending commands that expect responses, one-way commands, and variants with additional parameters such as content type and properties.

classes.name: LegacyCommandClient
classes.description: A Java interface in the Eclipse Hono framework that specifies methods for sending commands to a device, handling responses, one-way commands, and including optional headers and content types.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with optional data to a device, expecting a response wrapped in a Future; can specify command name and data buffer.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with specified content type, data, and properties, expecting a response wrapped in a Future.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way command (no response expected) with optional data buffer.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way command with specified content type, data, and properties, without expecting a response.
